title: Structure Lift
description: Admin-only tool for server operators to select, lift, and relocate entire buildings — including chests, signs, and all block data.
body:
# Structure Lift

**Move entire buildings with a single command!**

Structure Lift is an admin-only tool for server operators that lets you select, lift, and relocate entire structures — including all block entity data like chests, signs, and furnaces.

## Features

- **Structure Wand** — Select buildings by right-clicking two corners
- **Move Command** — Relocate structures to any coordinates instantly
- **Full Undo** — Made a mistake? One command restores everything
- **Block Entity Support** — Chests keep their contents, signs keep their text
- **Visual Feedback** — Particle effects and sounds when moving structures
- **Admin Only** — Only server operators (permission level 2+) can use it

## Commands

- /structurelift wand — Get the Structure Wand
- /structurelift move x y z — Move selected structure to coordinates
- /structurelift undo — Undo the last move
- /structurelift clear — Clear your selection
- /structurelift info — Show selection info

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1+
